Jaime places eggs on the tray. Each tray can hold 24 eggs. If he has 64 eggs and 2 trays, how many eggs won't he be able to place on the tray?

End your reply with a line of the form 'Final answer: N', where N is the final number.

Two trays can hold \(2 \times 24 = 48\) eggs.

\(64 - 48 = 16\) eggs won’t fit.

Final answer: 16
